verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own API README tells clients to read the `Retry-After` header before retrying, which shows the API enforces throttling and documents how to back off. The pack does not state the actual request limits or any concurrency caps. missing for 10: documented numeric rate limits (requests per time window), documented concurrency caps, explicit 429/throttling policy details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale

citations.quote: Consult the `Retry-After` response header to determine how long to wait (in seconds) before retrying the request.
